items.situation: I let out a moist, hot, nasty fart in front of all my co-workers today. I was so mortified.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: At the staff meeting today, I thought I could keep it quiet, but everyone heard it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did anyone say anything?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The room went still, and then someone opened a window.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That made it hard to pretend nothing had happened.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I said it was my chair, but nobody looked at the chair.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Was your manager there?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: She was sitting right across from me, taking notes.

items.situation: One time I was exercising in a yoga class and my pants split open!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I was in yoga class once, and during a stretch my pants split open.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Right in the middle of the class?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yeah, we were all facing the mirrors, and I noticed a tear at the back.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did anyone say anything?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The instructor just kept talking, so I tied my sweatshirt around my waist.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That was a practical move. How did you get through the rest of class?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I stayed near the wall until it was over, then went straight home.

turns.speaker: B

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: At least the door was closed again after that.

items.situation: I had to give a presentation at work the other day. I forgot to bring in the slides for the presnetation so I ended up having to try to do it with no materials. That was such an awkward experience.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I gave a presentation at work the other day, but my slides were still at home.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: So you had to present without any of the material you prepared?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yeah, I had to talk through everything from memory and use the whiteboard.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did anyone have a copy of the slides, or were you on your own?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No one had them. I just kept going until the meeting was over.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: At least you got through the whole presentation.

items.situation: I was in Walmart and my son pulled a few items off the shelf onto the floor, everyone was looking.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I was in Walmart with my son when he pulled a few things off a shelf onto the floor.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did they all come down at once?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: A couple of boxes and some packages landed around the cart, and people nearby looked over.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Was he still reaching for more while you were picking them up?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: He had one more item in his hand, so I took that and started putting everything back.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did anyone from the store come by?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: An employee walked past, and I had the shelf mostly cleared by then.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: At least it was only a few items instead of the whole display.

items.situation: I forgot I was wearing makeup. I rubbed my face then walked around with eyeliner smeared all over.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I forgot I had makeup on today and rubbed my face while I was walking to the store.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did you notice anything was off before you got there?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Not until I caught my reflection in a window. The eyeliner was smeared across both sides of my face.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: And you had already been walking around like that?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I had stopped for coffee and talked to the cashier.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did anyone say anything?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No, so I only found out when I saw myself.

items.situation: I spilled my tea on my lap today and it looked awful. Like I peed myself.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I spilled tea on my lap today just before I had to leave. It soaked through the front of my pants.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Were you able to change, or did you have to go out like that?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I had no time, so I tied a sweater around my waist. The tea left a dark patch underneath.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That must have made the whole trip complicated.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Every time I looked down, the stain was still there. It looked like I'd had an accident.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did anyone say anything when you arrived?

items.situation: I sprain my ankle really often. I'm not great at basic walking

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I rolled my ankle again walking over to the kitchen.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Was there anything in the way?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No, just the floor and a turn I have made plenty of times.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Is it the same ankle as last time?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yeah, it seems to find a new angle whenever I am not paying attention.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Can you put weight on it?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: A little. I have ice on it and I am trying not to move around.

turns.speaker: B

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I borrowed a dress from my sister and changed the rest of the plan.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: At least you had something that worked for the day.

items.situation: I tripped over the sidewalk the other day, thankfully no one was around

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I caught my toe on a raised bit of sidewalk the other day and went down.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Was anyone nearby when it happened?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No, the street was empty, so I got up and kept walking.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did you check what made you catch your toe?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, the cart was full, and the cashier had started ringing things up.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did you leave the cart there and go back for your wallet?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I told the cashier what happened, put the items aside, and drove home for it.

items.situation: I passed gas while on my first date with a girl last night. I didn't mean to, it just slipped out.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I was on my first date last night, and I passed gas at the table.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did she notice what happened?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: She looked up for a second, and then we both kept talking about the menu.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: So the date carried on after that?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yeah, we finished dinner and walked around for a while afterward.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did either of you mention it later?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No, we just said goodnight when her ride got there.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Maybe you will find out when you talk again.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did anyone from the shop see you?

turns.text: A barista came outside with napkins, and I was still holding the cup somehow.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: At least the coffee stayed with you?

turns.text: Most of it did, although my sleeve ended up wearing the rest.

turns.text: What did she say?

turns.text: She said she already had plans, and the people by the coffee machine heard it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Were they close enough to hear the whole question?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Close enough that someone stopped pouring coffee while she answered.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: And then you still had to stand there and finish your drink.

items.situation: I walked around for half the day with my pants unzipped before I realized it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I just realized I've been walking around since breakfast with my pants unzipped. I only noticed when I sat down.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did nobody say anything to you? That's a long time for no one to mention it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I went to the pharmacy, got coffee, and stood in line at the bank.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Maybe people assumed someone else would tell you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I caught my reflection in a shop window and finally saw it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That makes it hard to tell whether anyone noticed.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I fixed it and kept thinking about every person who might have seen it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Either way, the zipper stayed open through all of that.

items.situation: On the way home on my bike, I couldn't hold it in any longer and I... went to the bathroom on myself. #2. It was horrible. I had another mile to go before I got back to my house. So much to clean up. I felt so mortified!

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I was biking home and couldn't hold it any longer. I had an accident before I got to the house.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: You still had the rest of the ride ahead of you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: About a mile. I got home and went straight inside.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did you have anything with you that helped on the way?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No, just my bike and what I was wearing. There was a lot to wash once I got home.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That made for a long trip home. Is everything cleaned up now?

items.situation: I was shopping the other day and was convinced the cashier had over charged me. I confronted her and finally asked to speak to a manager because I did not feel that I was getting any response. The manager proved to me that I was wrong.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I was shopping the other day and thought the cashier had charged me too much.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: What made the total look wrong to you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I compared it with the shelf label and asked her to check the price.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did she find anything when she checked?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We went through the receipt, and I asked to speak with a manager when I still did not understand it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: What did the manager find?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The manager showed me that the sale label was for a different size than the one I bought.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: So the total was right, but the label did not match your item.
